Critics Consensus Stylish, thrilling, and giddily kinetic, John Wick serves as a satisfying return to action for Keanu Reeves -- and what looks like it could be the first of a franchise. Read Critics Reviews Nick Schager The Daily Beast 11/09/2015 If John Wick is the best looking action film in recent memory, it's also bolstered by a phenomenal cast of actors who, be they in parts big or small, manage to craft three-dimensional characters out of stock archetypes. Go to Full Review Jonathan Romney Observer (UK) 04/12/2015 An almost zen-like exercise in wholesale slaughter as abstraction. Go to Full Review Donald Clarke Irish Times 04/10/2015 Emotions matter little. Story matters less. Morals don't register at all. But the rhythm of the killing creates its own irresistible machine music. Go to Full Review Eddie Harrison film-authority.com Mar 18 a fantasy that appeals because real life is tough, and watching one good man cut through all the nonsense makes for a truly epic watch Go to Full Review Ankit Ojha Cinema Elite 07/09/2024 Ultimately, “John Wick” is a testament to the fact that plots don’t matter; it’s how stories are told that actually does. The film knows precisely what kind of movie it is: one that kicks serious ass and provides moviegoers a fantastic time out. Go to Full Review Emiliano Basile EscribiendoCine 07/01/2024 John Wick is pure TNT and without a doubt, Keanu Reeves' best movie since The Matrix (1999). [Full review in Spanish] Go to Full Review Read all reviews Sarge C4 Defense Jan 2 Although Ive seen this movie at least a dozen times, I 10 outta 10 recommend seeing it on the big screen. The action, the audio, and the story is so much better in theatre. Treat yourself and go see John Wick today. See more IG Jan 1 Still just as good as when it first released back in 2014. Stacie May 25 will rewatch this EVERY DAY OF MY LIFE! MBSC 03/30/2025 Love Keanu Reeves movies! Love the John Wick character! Abraham 11/08/2024 Amazing action and very simple storyline to follow. Keanu Reeves was the perfect choice for this role. I recommend 100% Steve in PA 04/09/2023 Best action movie with constant intense action. Incredible stunts. Keanu is an actor of few words, and John Wick films are much like Clint Eastwoods Dirty Harry series. Does not disappoint. Goes bigger than the previous three, and theres even a dog that gets plenty of revenge. Her sudden death leaves John in deep mourning. When sadistic mobster Iosef Tarasov (Alfie Allen) and his thugs steal John's prized car and kill the puppy that was a last gift from his wife, John unleashes the remorseless killing machine within and seeks vengeance. Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head.
